Name: Shaphir
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Tell as Sawafir, Khirbet el Qom, and Tell Eton
Description: Shaphir was a town named in Micah's lament over the towns of the Shephelah, told that its inhabitants would go out in nakedness and shame.
BiblicalSignificance: Shaphir's name, meaning fair or beautiful, is turned against it in Micah's wordplay: the fair town would be exposed.
